title: Personal Checking: Converting an Account to Another Tier
content:
## What a conversion changes

A Personal Checking tier conversion keeps the account number, the balance and the full history; only the tier is replaced. It carries no charge, and the early closure window keeps running from the original opening.

## Conversions the customer asks for

A requested conversion may be recorded only if all of the following hold, each read from the bank's records:

- the account is active at the time the conversion is recorded;
- on the conversion date the customer satisfies the target tier's entry gate, with the opening deposit left out of it (age from the profile's date of birth, and any relationship floor the target tier sets);
- the conversion does not break either account-count ceiling for the target tier — the product-wide one or the target tier's own;
- the account has had no other conversion at the customer's request during the statement cycle now running, since one per account per cycle is the most allowed.

## Conversions the bank makes

- **By age.** When a tier sets a conversion age, the bank moves the account into the tier's conversion target at the first statement cycle close falling on or after the owner reaches that age.
- **Private Client downgrade.** When a Private Client Checking account ends 3 consecutive statement cycles with its relationship balance under the tier's entry floor, the bank moves it down to Premier Checking when the following cycle closes.

## Fees around a conversion

Whatever tier the account holds when a cycle closes is the tier whose charges apply to that cycle.

## Hypothetical cases

- A Student Checking owner turns the tier's conversion age on the 12th; the cycle closes on the 20th of that month, so the move happens at that close.
- A Private Client Checking account below the floor at three cycle closes in a row is converted at the fourth close; if the second close had been at or above the floor, the run would restart.
- An owner who already converted the account earlier in this cycle cannot convert it again until a later cycle.
